title: videos paged summary record (v1)
description: The terminal record of a successful multi-request videos pagination run: the deduplicated result count, the requested page budget, the pages received, the duplicates removed, and the most recent exchange's status and identifiers. Videos documents no continuation field, so the page budget is the walk's sole terminator and requested pages equal the budget the invocation was given. Per-request metadata, including each pacing wait, lives in the JSON envelope's upstream array, not in JSONL records.
